title: commitwork scanner-binary roster
description: The tools monitor/scanner-binary.mjs pins (path + sha256 + version) against its accepted baseline. Applied at read time by readRoster() — a malformed roster refuses to load rather than silently pinning a different tool set than the one declared.

versionArgs.description: per-tool because there is no convention; a wrong flag degrades to version-unreadable, never to a fabricated version
